source_campaign_rule: Reuse exactly the same deterministic scene generator, initial gates, nominal MPC, RA-DPCBF barrier, dynamic radius, input limits, sample-hold margin and stopping rule.
change_scope: Only the lifecycle of the existing chi-Gamma auxiliary row is changed. The base sampled RA-DPCBF safety QP is the default controller.

scene.rejection_rule: Identical to the source campaign; no controller outcome is inspected.

threshold_policy: Thresholds are fixed from physical/control scales before formal seeds 1000--1099. Development seeds may verify implementation but may not be used to optimize formal outcomes.
reuse_policy: MA-CBF-VO, C3BF, Park-inspired 3D DPCBF and original RA-DPCBF rows are reused byte-for-byte; they are not rerun.
